package repository

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

type OutboxClaim struct {
	WorkerID    string
	Limit       int
	Now         time.Time
	LockedUntil time.Time
}

type Outbox interface {
	Claim(context.Context, OutboxClaim) ([]domain.IntegrationEvent, error)
	MarkPublished(context.Context, string, string, time.Time) error
	MarkFailed(context.Context, string, string, string, time.Time) error
}
